findings.description: From 00:07.25 to 00:08.25 the apple, which has been held against the umbrella fist since 00:00, progressively shrinks into the closed hands (full apple at 00:07.25, sliver at 00:07.50, tiny fragment at 00:07.75, speck at 00:08.00) and is gone by 00:08.25, with the hands simply closing together on the umbrella shaft. There is no release, drop, transfer or pocketing motion; the fingers close through the space the apple occupied.
